name: Krebs and NVD IOC Extractor and summarizer

parameters.filterByFormula: AND({Processing Status} = 'New', OR({Raw Description} != '', {Raw Content} != '', {Title} != ''), OR({AI Processed} = 0, {AI Processed} = BLANK()), {IOC Value} = BLANK())

nodes.name: Get New Krebs/NVD Threat Records
nodes.notes: Pulls unprocessed Krebs RSS and NVD CVE rows from the Threats table. No Flowise/Groq is used.

nodes.name: Summarize and Extract IOCs Directly
nodes.notes: No Flowise/Groq. Uses deterministic JavaScript rules to summarize Krebs/NVD rows and extract IPs, domains, URLs, hashes, emails, and CVEs.

nodes.name: Update Threat Record with Summary and IOCs
nodes.notes: Updates the original Threats row with a direct, no-Flowise summary and extracted IOC fields.

nodes.name: Build IOC Records from Direct Extraction
nodes.notes: Outputs one item per extracted IOC. Adds IOC Key for deduplication and Last Seen for update logic.

nodes.name: Search Existing IOC Record
nodes.notes: Searches for an existing IOC record using Dedupe Key = IOC Key.

nodes.name: Create New IOC Record
nodes.notes: Creates an IOC row in the Threats table from direct regex/NVD extraction. If you use a separate IOC table, change this node plus Search/Update IOC nodes.

nodes.name: Update Existing IOC Record
nodes.notes: Updates existing IOC row in Threats based on Dedupe Key/IOC Key.

main.node: Update Threat Record with Summary and IOCs
